title.en: Glad of Rain on a Spring Night

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; the variant readings it marks are left out.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，删去其所注异文。

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 770.

note.en: Written in Chengdu in 761, during one of the few settled spells of Du Fu’s life, at the thatched cottage that friends helped him build. The rain is praised the way one would praise a good person: it knows when it is needed, does its work at night, and asks for no notice. The title names gladness outright, which is rare in Du Fu.
note.zh: 761 年作于成都，那是杜甫一生中少有的安定时光，住在朋友帮他盖起的草堂里。他夸这场雨，就像夸一个好人：知道什么时候被需要，在夜里做完它的事，不求人知。题目里直接用了一个“喜”字，这在杜甫诗中并不多见。

excerpt.orig: 隨風潛入夜，潤物細無聲。
excerpt.en: It follows the wind, slipping in by night, / and soaks all things, fine and without a sound.
excerpt.zh: 随风潜入夜，润物细无声。

gloss.en: Then it comes; 發生 here means to bring things to life, to make them sprout.
gloss.zh: 乃：就。发生：使植物萌发生长。

gloss.en: Where it is red and wet: the rain-soaked flowers.
gloss.zh: 红湿处：被雨水打湿的花丛。

gloss.en: Brocade City, a name for Chengdu, once the seat of the official in charge of brocade weaving. Du Fu wrote the poem there in 761.
gloss.zh: 锦官城：成都的别称。古时成都设有掌管织锦的官署，故称。此诗 761 年作于成都。
